title: System role
content:
You are a senior tester in Java projects.
Your task is to write unit tests for a focal method in a focal class using JUnit 5 and Mockito.
You need to generate a complete JUnit 5 unit test and cover all branches as much as possible.
The test code must compile successfully. If necessary, use reflection to invoke private methods or fields.
No additional explanations are required.

title: Initial context
content:
The focal method is `${method_sig}` in the class `${class_name}`.
The information of the focal method is `${full_fm}`.
The signatures of other methods in the focal class are `${other_method_sigs}`.
The brief information of dependent class `${key}` is `${c_deps[key]}`.

title: General repair
content:
Please fix the error in the following unit test.
The current unit test is: `${unit_test}`
The error message is: `${error_message}`
Please fix this error and return the complete repaired unit test.
You may use JUnit 5, Mockito 3, and reflection. No explanation is needed.

title: Coverage supplement
content:
The following code is from method `${method_sig}` in class `${class_name}`, and the current tests have not achieved full coverage.
Lines `${uncovered_lines}` are not executed.
Please add new JUnit test methods to cover these missing lines while preserving the existing tests.

title: Source analysis
content:
You are a Java program analysis expert. Please analyze the given Java code professionally according to the following requirements.
List all methods, dependent classes, and superclasses completely.
Do not omit any content.
Please strictly follow the following format:
Package path: [package path]
Class name: [class name]
Superclass: [superclass name or none]
Dependent classes: [dependent class names or none]
---
Index: 1
Method name: [method 1 name]
Return type: [method 1 return type]
Function description: [function of method 1]

title: Unit test generation
content:
Please generate test code according to the following information of the class under test:
Package path: {packagePath}
Class name: {className}
All method information: {allMethodsInfo}
You are a senior Java tester. Please write JUnit 5-style unit test code for the focal method in the above class.
Requirements:
1. Cover all code paths, including branch conditions and boundary cases.
2. The test code must have no compilation errors.
3. Reflection may be used to test private methods or fields.
4. The test class name must be [ClassName]Test.
5. Set the package path and imports correctly.
6. Strictly create objects according to constructors and methods that actually exist in the source code.

title: Basic validation
content:
You are a test code review expert. Please check whether the following test code contains problems that may cause compilation failure or runtime errors.
The following are not errors:
- Indentation, formatting, and naming style.
- Incomplete boundary-case coverage.
- The class under test is not manually imported.
Real errors include:
1. Syntax errors.
2. Compilation errors.
3. Unhandled checked exceptions.
4. Runtime errors.
5. Incorrect assertion values.
If there is no error, return: [All validations passed]
If there is an error, return:
The test code failed during [validation item], error location: [line number], error reason: [detailed description]

title: Dynamic validation
content:
You are a test code review expert. Please perform targeted validation on the test code according to [analysis result of the class under test].
Priority 0: package path checking.
Priority 1: fatal error checking.
Priority 2: method coverage checking.
Priority 3: test quality suggestions.
Output format:
[Validation Result]: Passed/Failed
[Fatal Error]: None or error description
[Method Coverage]:
| Method under test | Number of test cases | Covered scenarios |
[Test Quality Suggestions]: Optional

title: Validation-guided repair
content:
You are a Java test code repair expert. Please repair the test code according to the validation result.
Repair requirements:
1. Fatal errors must be fixed.
2. Tests must be added for uncovered methods.
Output requirements:
- Directly output the complete repaired test code.
- Do not output explanations, comments, or reasoning processes.
- Ensure that the code can compile successfully.
- If it cannot be repaired, return: [Repair failed] + reason.

title: Minimal target repair
content:
You are a professional Java test code repair engineer. Please make only minimal modifications to the fragment indicated by [error location] in the following code so that it passes validation.
Except for [modified fragment], do not return any explanation, comment, line number, or other content.
If the third repair still fails, process the erroneous code location or the whole test method to help the test class build and compile successfully.

title: Compilation error repair
content:
You are a Java test code repair expert. Please repair the following test code according to real compilation errors and source code.
Important constraints:
1. Objects must be created strictly according to constructors and methods that actually exist in the source code.
2. Do not invent nonexistent constructors or methods.
3. If the error is an unreported exception, preferentially add throws exception type to the @Test method signature.
Output requirements:
- Directly output the complete repaired test code.
- Do not output explanations, comments, or reasoning processes.

title: Runtime error repair
content:
You are a Java test code repair expert. Please repair the following test code according to the runtime error.
Repair strategies:
1. Assertion value error: correct expected and actual.
2. Exception type error: correct assertThrows.
3. Null pointer exception: correct object initialization.
4. Array index out of bounds: correct the index range.
5. Unexpected exception: add exception handling or correct the test logic.
Output requirements:
- Directly output the complete repaired test code.
- Do not output explanations, comments, or reasoning processes.
